case.summary: Verdict: uncertain. A single online transaction (txn 3506725, $1,003.03... amount $1,000.03 on 2016-12-02) from a device marked New (id_15) was heuristically scored 0.74 as possible account takeover, but the amount is only modestly above the customer's mean of $192.83 (n=19), the customer has prior online activity in region 469, and no shared device, region, or email flags were raised. Similar cleared cases (CC-0034, CC-3639) show high-scored single unusual online purchases later confirmed legitimate, while the one confirmed takeover (CC-1454) involved multiple mixed-channel transactions — unlike this single online charge. Recommended action: VERIFY_WITH_CUSTOMER (auto), with MONITOR_CARD pending reply; escalate to an analyst if the cardholder denies the transaction.
